author: Hardik Pandya
installation: One-time OMP adaptation; no upstream runtime, commands, hooks, or automatic updates
adaptations: Made the skill naturally discoverable for prose drafting and editing, including technical explanations, reports, emails, and documentation, plus direct anti-slop prompts.
Recast upstream patterns as contextual cues instead of blanket rules; removed absolute bans and scoring or rewrite loops.
Added preservation requirements for claims, scope, modal strength, warnings, uncertainty, identifiers, quotations, structured content, code, and links.
Directed explicitly named humanizer or naturalize-documentation requests to humanizer, and plain-English technical explanations to simple-english.
